cross-product-7df7b6fd.interpretation: Cross-Product: The specific part of the probability formula that distinguishes quantum addition from classical addition.
cross-product-7df7b6fd.limits_and_boundary: Great Expansion: Limiting case analysis pending.

flux-expulsion-6fe60edd.title: Flux Expulsion
flux-expulsion-6fe60edd.interpretation: Flux Expulsion: The extreme boundary condition where a material becomes a perfect diamagnet, forcing B to be zero inside.
flux-expulsion-6fe60edd.limits_and_boundary: Great Expansion: Limiting case analysis pending.

geometric-result-dd62089f.title: Geometric Result
geometric-result-dd62089f.interpretation: Geometric Result: How the total density of all matter and energy dictates the shape of space.
geometric-result-dd62089f.limits_and_boundary: Great Expansion: Limiting case analysis pending.

gyro-shift-944fa7de.title: Gyro Shift
gyro-shift-944fa7de.interpretation: Gyro Shift: The measurable change in the orientation of an orbiting object caused by the central spin.
gyro-shift-944fa7de.limits_and_boundary: Great Expansion: Limiting case analysis pending.

bekenstein-bound-b8cdbdba.title: Bekenstein Bound
bekenstein-bound-b8cdbdba.interpretation: Bekenstein Bound: The absolute maximum amount of data that can be stored in a given region of space.
bekenstein-bound-b8cdbdba.limits_and_boundary: Great Expansion: Limiting case analysis pending.

fixed-scale-69fa9732.title: Fixed Scale
fixed-scale-69fa9732.interpretation: Fixed Scale: The 150-megaparsec "measuring stick" used to map the size of space.
fixed-scale-69fa9732.limits_and_boundary: Great Expansion: Limiting case analysis pending.

expansion-rate-2ca06350.title: Expansion Rate
expansion-rate-2ca06350.interpretation: Expansion Rate: The graph of speed vs. time that reveals the contents of the universe.
expansion-rate-2ca06350.limits_and_boundary: Great Expansion: Limiting case analysis pending.

pressure-cap-067995de.title: Pressure Cap
pressure-cap-067995de.interpretation: Pressure Cap: Why particles moving at "c" can't push back any harder as you squeeze them.
pressure-cap-067995de.limits_and_boundary: Great Expansion: Limiting case analysis pending.

invariant-baseline-aa2c1c88.title: Invariant Baseline
invariant-baseline-aa2c1c88.interpretation: Invariant Baseline: The internal energy of a particle when it is at a complete stop.
invariant-baseline-aa2c1c88.limits_and_boundary: Great Expansion: Limiting case analysis pending.

path-collision-d70bcfdc.title: Path Collision
path-collision-d70bcfdc.interpretation: Path Collision: Why gravity always tries to force light and matter to crash into a single point.
path-collision-d70bcfdc.limits_and_boundary: Great Expansion: Limiting case analysis pending.

horizon-heat-a2039d8b.title: Horizon Heat
horizon-heat-a2039d8b.interpretation: Horizon Heat: The theoretical discovery that accelerating space has a real temperature.
horizon-heat-a2039d8b.limits_and_boundary: Great Expansion: Limiting case analysis pending.

generator-dynamics-c0eb438d.title: Generator Dynamics
generator-dynamics-c0eb438d.interpretation: Generator Dynamics: The commutator relation that defines the infinitesimal structure of a symmetry group.
generator-dynamics-c0eb438d.limits_and_boundary: Great Expansion: Limiting case analysis pending.

non-crossing-rule-d7588799.title: Non-Crossing Rule
non-crossing-rule-d7588799.interpretation: Non-Crossing Rule: The property that particle trajectories in configuration space are smooth and non-intersecting.
non-crossing-rule-d7588799.limits_and_boundary: Great Expansion: Limiting case analysis pending.

moment-of-a-couple-50577165.title: Moment of a Couple
moment-of-a-couple-50577165.interpretation: Moment of a Couple: A pure torque that is invariant under coordinate transformations of the origin.
moment-of-a-couple-50577165.limits_and_boundary: Great Expansion: Limiting case analysis pending.

identity-of-indiscernibles-d8279744.title: Identity of Indiscernibles
identity-of-indiscernibles-d8279744.interpretation: Identity of Indiscernibles: The logical rule asserting that if two entities share all the same relational properties, they are identically the same entity.
identity-of-indiscernibles-d8279744.limits_and_boundary: Great Expansion: Limiting case analysis pending.

wave-packet-integral-0d17064d.title: Free Particle Wave Packet
wave-packet-integral-0d17064d.interpretation: Constructs a localized matter wave by superimposing an infinite continuous spectrum of plane waves, mathematically defining the wave packet.
wave-packet-integral-0d17064d.symmetry_origin: The Fourier transform mapping between the momentum (k-space) and position (x-space) representations.
wave-packet-integral-0d17064d.limits_and_boundary: The spread of the spectral envelope $\phi(k)$ directly dictates the spatial uncertainty $\Delta x$, enforcing the Heisenberg limit.

normalization-constant-calc-e6ba49fe.title: Normalization Constant Identity
normalization-constant-calc-e6ba49fe.interpretation: Defines the scaling factor required to transform a mathematical solution of the Schrodinger equation into a physically valid state.
normalization-constant-calc-e6ba49fe.symmetry_origin: The linearity of the wave equation, where any multiple of a solution remains a solution.
normalization-constant-calc-e6ba49fe.limits_and_boundary: Applicable only to square-integrable functions; fails for non-localized states like un-truncated plane waves.

mass-operator-eigenvalue-equation-98c6e9.title: The Mass Operator Identity
mass-operator-eigenvalue-equation-98c6e9.interpretation: Defines the mass eigenstates as the basis vectors that diagonalize the kinetic Hamiltonian, where the eigenvalue $ represents the invariant rest-mass.
mass-operator-eigenvalue-equation-98c6e9.symmetry_origin: The translational invariance of the free-field Lagrangian density.
mass-operator-eigenvalue-equation-98c6e9.limits_and_boundary: Anchors the propagation characteristics of elementary particles within the Minkowski vacuum.

big-rip-singularity-time-scale-0d0b895d.title: Big Rip Singularity Scale
big-rip-singularity-time-scale-0d0b895d.interpretation: Predicts the divergence of the scale factor at a finite future time t_rip, where the cosmic expansion rate becomes infinite and tears apart all bound structures.
big-rip-singularity-time-scale-0d0b895d.symmetry_origin: The integration of the Friedmann equation for a constant w < -1.
big-rip-singularity-time-scale-0d0b895d.limits_and_boundary: Marks the 'End of Time' for a phantom-dominated manifold, where even subatomic particles are disassembled by the metric expansion.

band-gap-splitting-zone-boundary-fc65cca.title: Brillouin Zone Energy Splitting
band-gap-splitting-zone-boundary-fc65cca.interpretation: Quantifies the degenerate energy level splitting at the Brillouin zone boundary due to a weak periodic potential, established by the first-order Fourier coefficient of the potential.
band-gap-splitting-zone-boundary-fc65cca.symmetry_origin: The constructive interference of reflected electron waves at the zone edge, creating standing-wave states of different symmetries.
band-gap-splitting-zone-boundary-fc65cca.limits_and_boundary: Determines the magnitude of the band gap that distinguishes metals from insulators.
